verdict.rationale: GitCafe shows Buildkite builds on each repository's CI tab and as pull-request checks, and its MCP read tools expose CI results. That gives per-repository CI visibility, but only through an external CI provider, and nothing evidences an organization-wide view. Missing for 10: an org-level aggregated dashboard of workflow runs across repositories, native or broader CI provider support beyond Buildkite, cross-repo filtering or reporting of runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
